title: OUR SERVICES & Core Offerings
sub: Everything we do at The Cane House — from live mobile event bars and turnkey franchises to daily fresh stall orders and wholesale.

items.title: Franchise Partnerships
items.desc: Join The Cane House family with our complete franchise blueprint. We provide bespoke commercial cold-pressing machinery, brand assets, certified staff training, supply logistics, and continuous operational mentorship.

items.title: Events & Live Catering
items.desc: Bring the theatrical aroma and freshness of live cane pressing to your celebration. Our uniformed 5-star hygiene artisans press fresh raw sugarcane juice right before your guests.

items.title: Fresh Stall & Shop Orders
items.desc: Experience 100% natural, unpasteurized cold-pressed cane juice made fresh on the spot. Available in Classic, Ginger Zing, Garden Mint, Chaat Masala, and Tropical blends.

items.title: Wholesale & Bulk Supply
items.desc: Reliable bulk delivery of raw, chilled sugarcane stalks and freshly extracted juice for restaurants, cocktail bars, and wellness centers across Greater London.
